source_documents.title: Rational Molecular Design for Achieving Persistent and Efficient Pure Organic Room-Temperature Phosphorescence

reference_evidence_units.quote: These molecules were found to be non-luminescent in the solution and amorphous states but strongly emissive in the crystalline phase in ambient conditions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1-5 incl. mFDBP (2)

reference_evidence_units.quote: In brief, pDBP (1) crystals emitted yellow light with a FP of 6.8%, and the crystalline powders of mFBDBF (2) showed a more intense green light with a higher FP of 17.7%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: mFDBP (2)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Green RTP, ΦP 17.7%, lifetime hundreds of ms.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The paper prints both 'mFDBP' and 'mFBDBF' for compound 2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The key issue is the synergistic effect of aromatic subunits and ketones, which realizes remarkably fast kISC and slow kP to afford balanced performance.
reference_evidence_units.subject: arylphenones 1-5
reference_evidence_units.statement: Hybrid (n,π*)/(π,π*) T1 gives fast ISC and slow kP.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Furthermore, in the crystal state, the vibrational motions are largely suppressed to block the nonradiative decay of T1 as a result of the environmental constraint.
reference_evidence_units.subject: arylphenones 1-5
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal rigidification suppresses non-radiative decay of T1.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The (n,π*)/(π,π*) mixing of T1 is used to tune the phosphorescence radiative rate kP and thus lifetime vs efficiency.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Persistent room-temperature phosphorescence from crystals; fast ISC through the hybrid T1.
